policy: Current Linktree Podcast platforms represented in this repository, plus plausible podcast listening destinations with show, episode, or RSS handoff evidence. Inclusion is an icon-design scope decision, not a claim of implemented Linktree integration or universal feed availability.

notes: Sonnet is retained as an active current platform; see platform-additions-2026-10/README.md.
SberZvuk in Linktree’s list maps to zvuk. RSS and Subscribe on Android remain subscription actions.
TIDAL is retained from Linktree’s published list for its limited podcast catalog, not as a general RSS player.
Previously excluded discontinued apps and creator tools are not restored merely because they appear in Linktree’s published list.
Unreviewed future repository platforms are excluded by default.
Queue, Neuecast, Netflix, and Yoto were explicitly included by the user on October 17, 2026; this does not assert verified show/feed handoffs for Queue or Neuecast.
